entries.label_en: 1. From 2018, hospitals report newly diagnosed cancer cases using the ROC-107 (2018) cancer-registry items. Hospitals with 50+ beds report incidence and treatment summary per the short-form manual; long-form-participating hospitals report stage, detailed treatment, recurrence, and other key cancer-care data for major cancers per the long-form manual (a small amount of data includes supplementary reports of cases diagnosed before 2017). 2. From diagnosis year 2002, the long-form TCDB first collected cervical, breast, oral, colorectal, liver, and lung cancers. 3. From 2008, prostate, stomach, esophagus, and bladder added (10 major cancers). 4. From 2009, nasopharyngeal, major salivary gland, uterine corpus, ovarian, and hematologic cancers added (15). 5. From 2013, laryngeal cancer added (16). 6. From 2022, pancreatic cancer added (17). 7. The long-form database uses three AJCC staging editions: cases diagnosed 2003-2009 use the 6th edition; 2010-2017 use the 7th edition; from 2018 use the 8th edition; cervical cancer diagnosed from 2021 uses the 9th edition. From the 9th edition on, each cancer's stage information is updated as needed. 8. For long-form analysis guidance, see the Taiwan Cancer Registry site: https://twcr.tw/?p=3284. 9. To analyze radiotherapy device or dose details, be sure to consult the Taiwan Cancer Registry long-form abstracting manual and note the correlations among radiotherapy fields.

entries.label_en: 1. From 2018, hospitals report newly diagnosed cancer cases using the ROC-107 (2018) cancer-registry items. Hospitals with 50+ beds report incidence and treatment summary per the short-form manual; long-form-participating hospitals report stage, detailed treatment, recurrence, and other key cancer-care data for major cancers per the long-form manual (a small amount of data includes supplementary reports of cases diagnosed before 2017). 2. From diagnosis year 2002, the long-form TCDB first collected cervical, breast, oral, colorectal, liver, and lung cancers. 3. From 2008, prostate, stomach, esophagus, and bladder added (10 major cancers). 4. From 2009, nasopharyngeal, major salivary gland, uterine corpus, ovarian, and hematologic cancers added (15). 5. From 2013, laryngeal cancer added (16). 6. From 2022, pancreatic cancer added (17). 7. The long-form database uses three AJCC staging editions: cases diagnosed 2003-2009 use the 6th edition; 2010-2017 use the 7th edition; from 2018 use the 8th edition; cervical cancer diagnosed from 2021 uses the 9th edition. From the 9th edition on, each cancer's stage information is updated as needed. 8. For long-form analysis guidance, see the Taiwan Cancer Registry site: https://twcr.tw/?p=3284. 9. To analyze radiotherapy device or dose details, be sure to consult the Taiwan Cancer Registry long-form abstracting manual and note the correlations among radiotherapy fields.

All cases in this database meet the eligibility criteria for long-term care.
notes_en:
1. This file can only be linked with the 'Key and Matching Fields' described below, see attachment on the last page of this manual for details.
※This center's database has been de-identified, with personal information such as names and addresses removed. Only fields like national health insurance numbers, facility codes, employer codes, unified numbers, dates of birth, medical visit dates, admission dates have been masked, and the data can only be used within a dedicated operational area of this department, and statistical results reviewed and approved before being carried out to ensure that the data cannot be linked back to specific individuals.
